1. (Currently amended) A compound of formula (IIa) O NaO OR2 O (IIa), in which substituent R2 is selected from the group consisting of alkyl, aryl, and arylalkyl, __wherein the compound exhibits enhanced enolate stability or reactivity compared to the corresponding potassium salt__.

2. (Currently amended) A compound according to Claim 1 of formula (IIa) in which R2 is C1-C12-alkyl, C6-aryl, or arylalkyl, __wherein R2 is methyl or ethyl and the sodium salt provides improved selectivity in nucleophilic addition reactions__.

3. (Currently amended) A compound according to Claim 1 of formula (IIa) in which R2 is methyl, __wherein the sodium enolate exhibits different reactivity characteristics than the corresponding potassium enolate__.

4. (Currently amended) A compound of formula (IIb) O ZO OMe O O (IIb) in which substituent Z is sodium, __wherein the sodium salt is prepared by a method comprising deprotonation of a β-keto ester with a sodium-based base__.

5. (Cancelled)
